strings.Este curso me ha enseñado a mirar una ru: This course has taught me to look at a route, a pool, a bicycle, a beach, a cove or a group activity from another perspective. Now I think more at the group level, the material, the weather, the risks, communication, escape points, inclusion, regulations and safety.
strings.Este primer curso no ha sido solo una su: This first course has not been just a sum of subjects. It has been the beginning of a different way of understanding adventure: with planning, safety, technique, respect for the environment and responsibility towards people.

strings.Gracias a todos los profesores que han f: Thanks to all the teachers who have been part of this first course. Each class, each outing, each correction, each practice and each work have been building a foundation that is now part of my way of understanding adventure.

strings.Gracias, Pablo, por enseñarme a mirar la: Thank you, Pablo, for teaching me to look at swimming with technical criteria and for helping me see a real evolution in the water. strings.Ha sido un verdadero placer teneros de p: It has been a real pleasure to have you as teachers. I have great respect, affection and admiration for all of you. A huge hug for everyone.

strings.Llegué a este ciclo con una pasión enorm: I came to this cycle with a huge passion for nature, sports, the sea, the mountains, adventure and strong emotions. But during 1st GMN I have begun to understand something much deeper: experiencing an activity is not the same as knowing how to prepare, guide, adapt, explain and evaluate it.
strings.Lo he pasado genial contigo y he aprendi: I had a great time with you and I learned a lot. This website is also born from that mix of technique, confidence, creativity and the desire to do something of your own. Thanks, machine.

strings.Me queda muchísimo por aprender, pero ah: I still have a lot to learn, but now I have something clearer than before: a direction. And that direction unites what has always moved me (nature, the sea, the mountains, sports and adrenaline) with a more professional, safe and responsible way of living it.

strings.Uno de los mayores cambios de este curso: One of the biggest changes of this course has been learning to look from the outside. Before I could think of a route because of how beautiful it was, of a jump because of the emotion or of an activity because of the sensations. Now I start to wonder who comes, what level they have, what material they need, what can go wrong, how it is explained, how it is adapted and how it is evaluated.

strings.Espero de verdad que el año que viene ta: I truly hope that next year you will also be our teacher in one of the modules. I mean it sincerely: it would be a privilege to keep learning with you and to share new practical sessions, outings and experiences.

strings.Espero que te vaya todo genial en los pr: I hope everything goes wonderfully for you in all the projects and stages ahead. Thank you for your work, your kindness and for turning a subject I already loved into an even more special experience.

strings.Gracias, Alberto. Nos hemos visto menos: Thanks, Alberto. We have seen less of each other and talked more at the end of the last evaluation, but it quickly shows that you are a person of ten and with a big heart. Your passion for nature, for travel and for everything you do is also evident. I am left with your calm and close way of being with the group, and with that feeling that there is still a lot to learn with you. See you next year on horseback riding, Alberto! I am very excited to be able to meet more with you and continue learning in a new discipline.
strings.Gracias, Antonio, porque has sido un des: Thank you, Antonio, because you have been a huge discovery. You are a phenomenon and I love how you transmit, how you teach and how you try to make sure that every second of class or practice is used as real learning. Thank you for your empathy, your closeness, those words you said to me on the beach and for everything I learned this year in cycling, in the aquatic environment, safety and working with the group. I really liked visiting schools and cycling circuits with the children. Feeling their enthusiasm, their special affection and that beautiful connection made me, at times, feel like just another child. I am left with a very clear basis to continue growing in the new areas of the coming year. I really hope that next year you will also be our teacher in some subject. I tell you from the bottom of my heart: it would be lucky to continue learning with you and share new practices, outings and experiences.
strings.Gracias, Beatriz, porque has sido una pr: Thank you, Beatriz, because you have been a wonderful teacher. I have learned with you many things that will help us in our daily professional life, especially when we work with foreign people and need to communicate clearly, politely and safely. As a person who loves English, it has been wonderful to have you as a teacher. I took with me vocabulary of material, sports, health, injuries, presentations, customer service and a more professional way of communicating. I hope everything goes great for you in the projects and stages you have ahead. Thank you for your work, your treatment and for making a subject that I already liked become an even more special experience.
strings.Gracias, Juana Mari, por todo lo que me: Thank you, Juana Mari, for everything you have taught me. It has been an immense learning experience and, above all, very functional for everyday life and for the world of work. I loved your effective way of teaching and transmitting. You are a wonderful teacher, and with you I have felt that very important content for the professional future could be understood in a clear, useful and close way. I take away rights and duties, risk prevention, first aid, contracts, employability, personal skills and a much more conscious way of building a professional project with a head. Thank you for making such an important subject feel practical, close and really useful.
strings.Gracias, Mariano, por ser mucho más que: Thank you, Mariano, for being much more than a teacher. For me you have also been one of those people that one feels like a friend for life. I take with me the routes, the conversations, the adjustments, the confidence and that way of yours of converting the bicycle and the aquatic environment into technique, effort, group and joy. I have learned a lot from you. I like the importance you give to every detail, to having everything under control and to convey to the group why preparation and information matter so much. You are a huge person and I love you very much. I am especially happy to know that next year we will meet again on Biological Foundations for Activities in the Natural Environment. I hope that we continue learning together and that we also live many adventures, including that pending night snorkel that is already part of the list of important plans.
strings.Gracias, Nacho, por hacer que aprender s: Thank you, Nacho, for making learning feel close, natural and fun. Your closeness with everyone, your jokes, your way of teaching and your way of accompanying the group have left a very special memory. I take away your treatment, your effort, the trust you have placed in me and the way in which you have turned each class into something much more human and easy to live with. With you you learn from closeness, but also from commitment and from the way in which you know how to pay attention to the group. Next year we'll see each other in ropes, if the path continues that way, and the truth is that I'm looking forward to it.
strings.Gracias, Pablo, por enseñarme a mirar la: Thank you, Pablo, for teaching me to look at swimming with technical criteria and for helping me see a real evolution in the water. In the videos, in the sessions and in everyday life in the pool I have noticed an enormous improvement, and I feel that a large part of that foundation comes from your trust, your closeness, your explanations and your way of working. I take with me your technical knowledge, your methodology, your way of correcting us and that ability to transmit passion for swimming until making each session count. Having closed the course celebrating that honors degree has a lot to do with everything you have invested in us. Your way of interacting with the group, your jokes and the simplicity with which you convey everything speak volumes about the great person you are. You have managed to ensure that technical work and demands coexist with closeness, a good atmosphere and the desire to continue learning.
strings.Gracias, Pepe, por enseñarme que una rut: Thank you, Pepe, for teaching me that a route is much more than walking. With you I have learned to plan, interpret, guide, assess risks, prepare materials, work with maps and think about the group before taking a step. I love the passion with which you talk about the mountains. It has been a true honor to have you as a teacher and to learn from someone who transmits so much respect for the natural environment and for all the activities that take place in it. Thank you for your trust, for your words, for your closeness and for that hug on the last day, when the first evaluation ended. They are gestures and learnings that stay. Hopefully next year I can continue learning rope maneuvers with you and that part of the course that for me has something almost magical, because it opens the door to activities such as canyoning, climbing or caving. I want to continue discovering that world with you, always based on technique, safety and respect for the mountains.
strings.Gracias, Puli. Fuiste quien me enseñó a: Thanks, Puli. You were the one who taught me how to do my first muscle up at the Royal Box, and this year you have also taught me a special part of digitalization, giving me the opportunity to develop even more in the digital world. I had a great time with you and I learned a lot. This website is also born from that mix of technique, confidence, creativity and the desire to do something of your own. Thanks, machine. Always continue to be you, because that energy, that authenticity and that natural way of connecting also teaches.
strings.Gracias, Samuel, porque fue un enorme pl: Thank you, Samuel, because it was a great pleasure to have had you as a tutor and teacher during the first part of the course. Your closeness, your sympathy and your way of facing each situation said a lot about you and left a very positive mark on the group. Although the course changed stages later, I remain with your good humor, your friendly way of explaining, and the confidence you conveyed in the classes and outings we shared. I hope that everything goes well for you in what you are doing and that you continue to carry with you that positive way of being with people.
